own_solution.law: Bernoulli + continuity, manometer: p1 - p2 = (rho_m - rho) g h; Q = A2 sqrt(2 (p1 - p2) / (rho (1 - (A2/A1)^2)))
assumptions: steady, incompressible, inviscid flow with uniform speed (stated)
manometer liquid immiscible and denser than flowing liquid

notes: All strata agree with pass 1 (pass 1 answers were in m^3/s; 0.01104 m^3/s = 11.04 L/s). R checks: 1590 -> dp = 693.84 Pa, Q = 2.389 L/s; 2500 -> 3.809 L/s; 3100 -> dp = 2469.6 Pa, Q = 4.507 L/s. All replacement densities exceed 1000 kg/m^3, so the manometer reading is physical. Wide-section form Q = (pi d1^2/4) sqrt(2 dp/(rho((d1/d2)^4 - 1))) is equivalent to my throat form.
